title: Hand Pollination and Pruning Techniques for Softwood Production
reason: The video describes processes related to pollination and pruning of source up trees, providing practical steps for increasing yield and fruit quality.

tasks.task: Explain the process of pollination in source up trees.

subtasks.text: Demonstrate hand pollination by brushing pollen grain from one flower to the stigma of a receptive flower.
Show the development of fruits after pollination.
Demonstrate the packaging of developing fruits to protect them from pests.

tasks.task: Describe pruning techniques for source up trees.

subtasks.text: Show the opening of the center of the source up tree to allow sunlight and air circulation.
Illustrate the elimination of new shoots to maintain the tree's shape.
Demonstrate the pruning of excessively high branches to prevent overcrowding.
Explain the importance of consistent pruning for increasing yield and fruit quality.
